release_notes:
1. GA4 select_item Tracking: Emits select_item with complete list context (item_list_id, item_list_name) and item parameters (item_id, item_name, sku, brand, category, price, index) on category/search listing clicks.
2. Quick View & Direct Navigation Support: Intercepts native prestashop.on('clickQuickView') and direct link clicks during pre-unload capture phase.
3. Zero DOM Scraping: 100% backend data correlation from authoritative server-hydrated listing state.
